settings.provenance: CPU/memory/fsync from broker process; API rate/log/port from allowlisted container environment; remaining source defaults at source_sha
settings.source_cleanliness: Git status excludes only the owned output directory; actual source-file fingerprint is checked again after execution
settings.topology: one broker; one database; one API; one consumer
settings.visibility_clock: API receipt and PostgreSQL observation share the deployment clock; host time schedules load

caveats: Local Docker VM; generator and SQL observer run on the same physical host as services and compete for resources.
Single broker, replication factor one. Disk-flush configuration does not establish tolerance of broker disk/host loss.
Topic and database settings are captured below. Source defaults at the recorded revision define remaining client settings.
Host filesystem reported by df is not a calibrated Docker VM disk specification. No dedicated disk latency or cloud cost measurement.
Resource samples are coarse Docker snapshots, not isolation or proof of a particular bottleneck.
